description.en: Lineage DAG of a dbt e-commerce project (sources → staging → intermediate → marts → exposures) across two commits: a model renamed with a new unique_id, a model split in two, a legacy model removed, a new mart, retargeted dependencies, table → incremental and tag / owner changes.
description.zh-CN: 一个电商 dbt 项目在两次提交之间的血缘 DAG（source → staging → intermediate → marts → exposure）：模型改名并更换 unique_id、一个模型拆分为两个、移除遗留模型、新增集市模型、依赖改指向、table 改为 incremental，以及标签与负责人变更。
